title: NK313 VIP Corn (NK313): Characteristics
metaDescription: NK313 VIP corn is a yellow yellow GM hybrid corn variety from Syngenta (NK). See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: NK313 VIP corn is a yellow yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK313. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Syngenta (NK).

heroImage.alt: A cornfield on a hillside in Pilar, Capiz, its leaves drying close to harvest, the kind of farm where NK313 VIP corn is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for NK313, this is the same corn. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).
Key facts about NK313 VIP corn

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Traits in the seed:** The VIP trait, sold under Syngenta's Protek Todo banner against fall armyworm and other corn caterpillars. Its page does not list the gene events.
Protected against fall armyworm and other corn caterpillars, the seller says.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on Syngenta's current Philippine corn list, under its Protek Todo banner. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant NK313 VIP corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK313 the same as NK313 VIP?
items.a: Yes. NK313 is another name for NK313 VIP. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK313 VIP?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
